name: transition-shape-mask-cut
title: Shape-Mask Transition
description: Cảnh tiếp theo hiện ra trong một ngôi sao năm cánh đặt giữa tiêu đề, ngôi sao phóng to và xoay cho tới khi phủ kín khung.

moworks.author: moworks

options.start: px of the star at the start (0; the recipe 0.4 em)
options.center: element the star is centred on (the frame's centre)
options.back: s after the start to shrink back (null: stay)

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Next scene clipped by a 5-point star (inner radius 45 % of outer) centred on the title; radius grows from ~0.4 em (21 px at 54 px type) to past the frame diagonal (100 → 3000 %) in 0.6 s power3.in (demo easeInCubic, CSS cubic-bezier(.55,0,1,.45)), rotating 0 → +30°; 1.5 px dark outline on the star edge until it leaves the frame. Demo: the star grows from 0, next scene = accent background with the second title; cut 1.2–1.8 s, back 3.0–3.6 s; loop 4.8 s. Params: shape: hình mặt nạ (sao 5 cánh) · duration (0.6 s, ease-in) · scale (100 → 3000 %) · rotate (30°).
